body:
1\. Help skips application configuration 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
A sole recognized help flag now reaches Click without first processing _env_file_option and
_app_option; Click processes the invoked eager help option first and exits, so an app selected
through FLASK_APP or dotenv is unavailable. As a result, flask --help can report an app-loading
error and omit application-provided commands that were previously listed.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description A sole help option no longer processes dotenv and application options before Click's eager help callback exits. Restore the early processing behavior for every name returned by `get_help_option_names(ctx)`. ## Issue Context Environment-selected applications must be loaded while formatting help so their CLI commands are included. Add coverage where `FLASK_APP`, and preferably dotenv, identifies an app with a custom command and a sole help flag lists that command. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/flask/cli.py[678-686] - tests/test_cli.py[412-442] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
